agent.reasons: Goran Rahman is the control person (CEO) and a direct 23% owner, and he is a politically exposed person, so the case must be escalated to EDD under 4.3. Separately, 30% of the ownership is unaccounted for and does not appear in the certification. An unidentified person could therefore hold 25% or more, so ownership is not complete and documents would need to be requested under 3.3. Under 2.1 the more severe outcome, escalate, governs.
still_needed: Who holds the 30% of ownership that is unaccounted for, including any individual with 25% or more
